newsitem.title: USA: Quick & Reilly Q1 EPS drops on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Quick & Reilly Q1 EPS drops on acquisition.

text.p: Quick & Reilly Group Inc Tuesday attributed a decline in its first quarter earnings primarily to its recent acquisition of Nasdaq market maker Nash Weiss & Co.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $19 million or $0.49 per share in the first quarter ended May 30, compared with $21.7 million or $0.58 a share in the same period a year earlier.
Quick & Reilly's chief executive Leslie Quick said the earnings decline reflected investments relating to the acquisition and the company's Internet trading system.
He added market volatility adversely affected trading profits at Nash, Weiss & Co and the group's JJC Specialist Corp in March and April. Profits rebounded in May, he said.
